page_title: BAY 2-2 LEV | Bayern Munich v Bayer Leverkusen 15/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Daniel Schlager is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
90+7' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+6' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Jonas Hofmann is replaced by Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen).
90+6' The substitution has been made. Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen) has replaced Florian Wirtz.
90+4' 2 - 2 Goal! Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Sven Ulreich into left side of the goal.
90+4' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) is going to take the penalty!
90+3' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
90+3' Referee Daniel Schlager makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
90+3' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+3' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Edmond Tapsoba.
88' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
86' 2 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) was set free in the area by Mathys Tel and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
85' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Konrad Laimer will be replaced by Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich).
85' Substitution. Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) replaces Harry Kane.
85' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it flies just over the bar.
85' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 8:4.
82' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Jeremie Frimpong.
80' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Sven Ulreich to make a comfortable save.
80' The ball is cleared after Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
78' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a mazy run, finds himself one-on-one with the keeper and fires the ball against the right post. What a missed opportunity.
76' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
74' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniel Schlager blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen in a dangerous position.
73' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
71' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is able to continue to play.
69' Thomas Tuchel has decided to make a change. Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) replaces Serge Gnabry.
69' Looks like Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
69' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
67' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) is penalised for holding. Daniel Schlager signals a set piece.
66' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
65' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
65' The ball is cleared after Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
61' Here is a change. Thomas Muller is going off and Thomas Tuchel gives the last tactical orders to Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich).
61' The game has come to an end for Joshua Kimmich. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich).
59' The resulting corner from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) comes to nothing.
57' What a huge chance for Harry Kane (Bayern Munich). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
57' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
55' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
52' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
51' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) slams the ball goalwards from 50 metres out, but his decent effort flies a whisker over the crossbar.
50' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
47' Daniel Schlager shows a yellow card to Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) for his blatant foul.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is replaced by Exequiel Palacios.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) blows a golden opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounces on the rebound to head the ball just wide of the left post.
45+1' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
45+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45+1' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Lukas Hradecky shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

44' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Lukas Hradecky inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
43' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.
43' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
42' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.

39' A terrific piece of skill by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
36' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) was quite harsh and Daniel Schlager didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
33' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) has a goal ruled out for offside!
31' Florian Wirtz plays a lovely pass into Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post.
28' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
27' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
25' Thomas Tuchel appears to have said too much and referee Daniel Schlager comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
24' 1 - 1 Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) scores a goal from the resulting free kick, sending it into the top right corner. What a strike that is, absolutely fantastic!
24' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
23' A corner kick by Bayer Leverkusen is thwarted by the well prepared Sven Ulreich (Bayern Munich).

23' A seemingly harmless indirect free kick challenged the defenders after Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) suddenly stepped up and fired the ball in following a touch from a teammate. However, the defence stood firm and cleared the danger.
23' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. Bayer Leverkusen earn a corner.
23' Bayer Leverkusen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
22' A pass by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
21' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' The corner is swung in but Bayern Munich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
18' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
17' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
14' The resulting corner from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared by the defence.
11' What a big chance! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
11' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich), but the defence gets it clear.
7' 1 - 0 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
7' The referee awards a corner and Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) goes over to take it.
6' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Lukas Hradecky comes off his line to intercept.
5' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
5' Daniel Schlager interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich).
4' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is moving okay again after that injury scare.

4' He should have scored! Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Lukas Hradecky makes an easy save.
3' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
2' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Bayer Leverkusen will take the kick-off.
Daniel Schlager is introduced as the referee for today's match.
